description: S45 T4 (PM1/PL1): the socket authoring door enforces the authorship rule EXACTLY ONCE — at the boundary — and carries its sentence across the wire VERBATIM, byte for byte, exactly as the reads' policyRefusal does. An allow authored from source "agent" is refused by checkAuthorship; the socket adds no interpretation (the boundary already named the fault and named the alternative), nothing is stored, and NO audit row is written for a refused write (PM8 — TestPolicyAddWritesExactlyOneAuditRow pins the refused side). The door is the human surface; being human does not exempt a write from PL1.

error.message: the authoring door refused the write

data.what: refused: Allow authored by source "agent" requires an operator (PL1) — a Deny or an Ask from "agent" would be accepted
data.means: nothing was stored and no audit row was written — a refusal is the boundary judging the row, not the machine failing; the closed vocabulary, PL1's authorship rule and the per-type specs are enforced exactly once, at the boundary, on every door
